blocks.text: Sequence Diagrams dikhate hain ke system ke objects ek khaas sequence (order) mein aapas mein kaise kaam (interact) karte hain. In se samajh aata hai ke waqt ke saath objects ke darmiyan messages kis tarah aate jate hain.

items: open(): user har dabba kholta hai.
put toys/books/clothes inside: user khilone, kitabein aur kapre apne apne dabbe mein daalta hai.
close(): user har dabba band karta hai.

blocks.alt: Chaar lifelines, User, Toys Box, Books Box aur Clothes Box, tooti hui (dashed) lakeeron ki soorat neeche jati hain. Teer order se User se dabbon ki taraf jate hain: har dabbe ko open(), put toys inside, put books inside aur put clothes inside, phir har dabbe ko close().
blocks.caption: Figure 1.11: User ka cheezein label wale dabbon mein rakhne ka sequence diagram (kitab ki Figure 1.11 ke mutabiq apni banayi hui drawing).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Sequence diagram oopar se neeche waqt ke order mein parha jata hai, aur teer message bhejne wale se message lene wale ki taraf jata hai. Kitab ki figure mein 'put toys/books/clothes inside' ke teer ulte, yani dabbon se User ki taraf, bane hain, jab ke kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke User cheezein dabbon mein daalta hai. Is liye yahan yeh teer User se dabbon ki taraf banaye gaye hain, jo sahi hai. Kitab mein aakhri close() teer lifelines khatam hone ke baad bana hai; yahan lifelines aakhri message tak barhai gayi hain.

blocks.title: Kitab ki ghalti
blocks.text: Kitab ki Figure 1.11 mein 'put toys/books/clothes inside' ke teer dabbon se User ki taraf bane hain, halan ke kitab ka apna text kehta hai ke User cheezein dabbon mein daalta hai. Sahi yeh hai ke yeh teer User se har dabbe ki taraf jayein, jaisa upar ki figure mein bana hai.

blocks.prompt: Food delivery application ke liye Sequence Diagram banayein jo order dene ka process dikhaye: customer ke items chunne se le kar order ki delivery tak. (Long Question 5)
blocks.explanation: Lifelines (objects): Customer, App, Payment Service, Restaurant, Rider. Upar se neeche messages: 1) Customer App ko order deta hai (order items); 2) App Payment Service se payment maangti hai; 3) Payment Service jawab mein payment confirm karti hai; 4) App order Restaurant ko bhejti hai; 5) Restaurant jawab mein order accept karta hai; 6) App Rider ko delivery assign karti hai; 7) Restaurant khana Rider ke hawale karta hai; 8) Rider order Customer tak pohanchata hai; 9) App Customer ko batati hai ke order deliver ho gaya. Jawab (return) wale messages tooti lakeer se dikhaye jate hain.

answer_figure.alt: Sequence diagram: oopar paanch dabbe Customer, App, Payment Service, Restaurant, Rider aur un ki tooti lifelines. Upar se neeche 9 numbered messages: order items, request payment, payment confirmed, send order, order accepted, assign delivery, hand over food, deliver order, order delivered.
answer_figure.caption: Jawab ka diagram (pehle khud banayein, phir milayein): food delivery order ka sequence diagram
answer_figure.long_description: Paanch lifelines baen se daen: Customer, App, Payment Service, Restaurant, Rider. Messages upar se neeche: 1. Customer se App: order items. 2. App se Payment Service: request payment. 3. Payment Service se App (tooti lakeer, jawab): payment confirmed. 4. App se Restaurant: send order. 5. Restaurant se App (tooti lakeer, jawab): order accepted. 6. App se Rider: assign delivery. 7. Restaurant se Rider: hand over food. 8. Rider se Customer: deliver order. 9. App se Customer: order delivered.

items: Sequence diagram: objects (lifelines) aur waqt ke order mein un ke messages.
Fig. 1.11: user har dabba open karta hai, cheezein andar daalta hai, phir close karta hai.
